The ShopBot Index data feed (planned)

We're planning a weekly data feed of everything our crawl records: which online stores publish a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read, what each profile declares, and which stores started or stopped publishing one. Join the waitlist to tell us what you need. Nothing is for sale yet and we won't charge anyone from this page.

Join the waitlist. Email hello@shopbotindex.com with the subject "Data feed waitlist", and tell us what you'd use it for. We'll reply personally, and only about the feed.

What the feed would include

  • Every retailer and store we track (2179 in our latest crawl, 2549 websites), with segment (Shopify stores, big retailers, other retailers & marketplaces), category and platform where we can tell.
  • Each website's result: UCP profile found, no UCP profile found, or couldn't check, with the HTTP status we got.
  • What each UCP profile declares: capabilities such as checkout, payment handlers, and the MCP endpoint if it names one.
  • The four supporting signals: agent tools, AI rules in robots.txt, AI guidance files and product data.
  • Weekly changes: which stores started or stopped publishing a UCP profile, newly tracked stores and stores we could no longer reach.
  • The weekly history for every store since our first crawl on 17 October 2026.

Who it's for

  • Agencies and apps that sell to online stores and want to know which stores already publish a UCP profile.
  • Teams building AI shopping agents that need a list of stores with a UCP profile and what each declares.
  • Analysts following how online stores adopt the Universal Commerce Protocol.

What stays free

Every store's result stays free on this site: the all-stores table, each store's page, Check your store, watch alerts and the Monday email. The feed is for people who need the whole dataset in bulk, every week.

From our latest crawl (2026-10-26)

  • 773 of the 1552 retailers and stores we could check publish a UCP profile.
  • We couldn't check 627 of the 2179 we track (blocked or unreachable), so they aren't counted.
  • A store with no UCP profile found isn't a store AI agents can't shop at; it's a store where we found no profile. How we measure.
